<Subject 1>: The same adult female protagonist throughout the entire video, using <Picture 1> as the sole identity reference. Preserve her exact facial identity, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin appearance, body proportions, height impression, and overall physical identity. In Segment 1, she begins slightly turned to the side, then naturally turns toward the camera and raises both hands into a clear playful photo-posing gesture, with her facial expression naturally matching the posing action. Maintain stable identity across every transformed look, action, camera angle, and comic collage.

<Subject 2>: The complete visual and acoustic environment appropriate to the protagonist's current look. During every card transition, the current look and environment remain unchanged until the selected card has completely exited the immediate foreground. The exact frame in which the card fully clears the foreground must simultaneously be the exact frame in which the next transformed look is already 100% complete.

<Subject 3>: Four independent character-selection cards featuring four different cartoon animals. The cards are separate graphic elements, never attached to, worn by, held by, printed on, or anatomically connected to the protagonist. In Segment 1 Shot 1, all four cards are static, vertically floating below the protagonist's chest, with clear physical separation from her body, and all four cards face directly toward the camera. Their fixed left-to-right arrangement is orange, pink-mint, green, yellow. In the initial Segment 1 state, each card is strictly ONE pure flat solid color plus ONE centered flat black silhouette of its own distinct cartoon animal. Each card uses only its own single card color with its black silhouette; there is absolutely no color mixing, multicolor pattern, gradient, color split, color transition, or additional colored graphic treatment. CRITICAL: all four cards remain completely motionless until the protagonist clearly selects the yellow card with her right index finger. Immediately after the yellow card is clearly selected, the orange, pink-mint, and green cards simultaneously begin their own independent exit-and-drop actions: each card moves away from its original position and exits downward/outward beyond the visible frame, clearly dropping out of the shot. Their exit-and-drop movement is brief, decisive, physically readable, and fully completed before the yellow card's main foreground reveal sequence finishes. The three unselected cards must never flip, transform, reveal their 3D animals, or return to their original positions. Only the selected yellow card performs the character-reveal flip. Every selected reveal card performs exactly ONE physical flip in the entire video. Each selected card's flip is autonomous and self-driven by the card itself, with no external force, hand contact, invisible mechanism, character assistance, or other object causing or assisting the rotation. After that one and only one complete flip, the selected card MUST immediately and clearly present its corresponding colored dimensional 3D cartoon-animal toy as the permanent post-flip card state. The 3D animal must be visibly non-human, volumetric, solid, dimensional, and clearly recognizable as a cartoon toy. No second flip, reverse flip, partial flip, repeated rotation, flat 2D animal after flipping, human character after flipping, or return to the black silhouette state.

<Subject 4>: The four comic photographic collages. Each collage contains exactly three separate static photographs of the same protagonist in the same current transformed look: one larger half-body main photograph positioned in the foreground, plus two smaller rectangular static close-up photographs positioned behind it. The two smaller photographs are placed at different positions in an intentionally irregular, asymmetric arrangement rather than aligned identically. The two rear photographs MUST remain completely static still photographs throughout the collage shot, with no independent movement, animation, pose change, facial change, live-action motion, parallax motion, or transformation. All three photographs must show exactly identical clothing, hairstyle, accessories, makeup, and styling. The two smaller photographs show the same woman in different poses, gestures, expressions, or actions. No full-body photograph. Each collage has its own distinct combination of cutout treatment, crisp white outlines, graphic borders, halftone-dot elements, crown graphics, and dimensional cartoon-animal/toy-sticker elements; the sticker and graphic-element combinations must differ clearly from the other three collages. The photographs remain completely static; only surrounding graphic elements may move very subtly.

detailed_description:
Fast, cheerful, playful live-action transformation aesthetic with polished commercial fashion-video energy, crisp action-match editing, comic-book collage styling, dimensional toy-card graphics, and controlled physical performance. Preserve the protagonist's real-person identity from <Picture 1>. Outside the designated photographic collages, never show two or more visible instances of the protagonist in the same frame. All cards are independent floating graphic objects featuring four different cartoon animals.

[Shot 1] Establish the original adult female protagonist in the original appearance, original hairstyle, original clothing, and original light-gray studio environment. She begins in a natural slight three-quarter side-facing posture. Four independent character-selection cards are already present as static vertical floating graphic elements below the protagonist's chest, clearly separated from her body and not attached to her in any way. The cards are arranged left-to-right: orange, pink-mint, green, yellow. Each card represents a different cartoon animal. CRITICAL: all four cards are facing directly toward the camera in a clear front-facing orientation and remain completely static and vertically suspended. Each card consists ONLY of one pure flat solid color plus one centered pure-black silhouette of its respective cartoon animal: the orange card is entirely solid orange with one black animal silhouette, the pink-mint card is entirely solid pink-mint with one black animal silhouette, the green card is entirely solid green with one black animal silhouette, and the yellow card is entirely solid yellow with one black animal silhouette. There is absolutely no color mixing, multicolor pattern, gradient, color split, color transition, or additional colored graphic treatment on any card. The silhouettes are simple, flat, graphic black shapes with no 3D volume, no realistic human face, no human anatomy, and no photographic rendering. All four cards remain completely motionless.

[Shot 2] The protagonist naturally rotates from her slight side-facing posture toward the camera. As she completes the turn, she raises both hands into a playful photo-shoot posing gesture, as if deliberately posing for a photograph. Her two hands are clearly visible and intentionally arranged in a cheerful, stylish photo-pose rather than forming a rectangular framing gesture. Her facial expression naturally matches the posing action: cheerful, playful, lively, and camera-aware, with a spontaneous photo-shoot smile and confident expression. The pose and facial expression occur together as one coordinated action. The four cards remain completely static, vertically floating below her chest, facing directly toward the camera. No card moves, rotates, flips, changes color, enlarges, approaches the camera, or produces any animated effect.

[Shot 3] She naturally completes the two-handed photo pose, lowers her hands smoothly, and then uses her right index finger to make one clear, deliberate selection gesture toward the yellow card. The right index finger visibly points at and selects the yellow card. Until the exact moment of selection, all four cards remain completely static and unchanged. Immediately after the yellow card has clearly been selected, the orange, pink-mint, and green cards simultaneously begin their own independent exit-and-drop actions. Each unselected card moves away from its original floating position and drops/outward beyond the visible frame. The three cards remain flat, front-facing, single-color cards with their black animal silhouettes during this exit. They do not flip, transform, reveal 3D animals, or return to their original positions. Their movement is clearly visible and physically readable, but does not interfere with the protagonist or the yellow card.

[Shot 4] The selected yellow card is the ONLY card performing a character-reveal flip. The orange, pink-mint, and green cards have already moved out of the visible frame and remain absent. The yellow card begins as its single solid yellow color with one flat black cartoon-animal silhouette. It moves independently toward the foreground and then performs exactly ONE complete physical flip. The flip must be a single continuous, autonomous physical rotation driven by the card itself, with no external force, no hand contact, no invisible mechanism, no character assistance, and no other object causing or assisting the rotation. After this one and only one complete flip, the card MUST immediately present a clearly visible colored dimensional 3D yellow cartoon-animal toy. The result must have obvious three-dimensional volume, thickness, depth, rounded or sculpted toy geometry, dimensional edges, material response, and lighting. It must never become a flat 2D illustration after flipping. No second flip, reverse flip, repeated rotation, partial return, or return to the black silhouette state.

[Shot 5] The yellow card independently moves completely out of the visible frame. The orange, pink-mint, and green cards are already absent from the frame after their completed exit-and-drop actions. The moment the yellow card has fully disappeared from the frame, the protagonist immediately and naturally continues the motion by raising a yellow instant camera toward her face. This is one continuous, believable physical action with no pause or reset. The camera reaches face level as the transformation transition occurs.

[Shot 6] Using the yellow instant camera movement as the action-match/occlusion transition, the protagonist's yellow transformed look is already 100% complete at the exact transition frame. She wears a yellow short-sleeve collared shirt, dark-blue butterfly bow tie, dark-blue star-pattern pleated short skirt, and neat hairstyle with a yellow star hair clip. Dedicated environment: light-blue studio world with yellow stars and comic-ray graphics. No original appearance remains.

[Shot 7] The yellow-look protagonist performs a restrained playful camera pose while holding the yellow instant camera. Maintain one visible protagonist only.

Exactly three separate static photographs of the same woman wearing exactly the same yellow outfit, hairstyle, star hair clip, makeup, and styling. [Shot 9] The orange card enters the yellow world as an independent vertical floating graphic element, never attached to the protagonist. It remains flat black while fully visible, then performs exactly ONE complete physical flip. Do not duplicate the exact sticker arrangement or sticker combination used in the yellow collage. The photographs remain completely static; only surrounding graphic elements move minimally.

[Shot 13] End Segment 1 on the completed orange-look state, with one protagonist only. Follow ALL rules below strictly.

1. TOTAL DURATION AND SEGMENTATION

First determine the requested total duration from the user's input.

If total duration is 15 seconds or less:

* Generate exactly ONE prompt segment.

* Do not introduce a segment separator.

  number_of_segments = ceiling(total_duration / 15)

Reusable visible content such as people, objects, environments, clothing, appearance, effects, actions, poses, styles, or other persistent visual elements.
